answer_1.quote: To extract aspect sentiment quadruplets, propose a new paradigm which transforms the quadruplet extraction into paraphrase generation problem. With pre-defined rules, they first map the four elements of (ac, at, ot, sp) into semantic values (x ac , x at , x ot , x sp ), which are then fed into a template to obtain a nature language target sequence.
answer_1.outputs: Paraphrase sequences encoding aspect sentiment quadruplets
